_comment: Minimal (简约科技 / 浅色) theme — clean light UI for reporting/demo. Soft white-gray surfaces, a single primary accent, restrained (or no) glow. Flat materials, no shadows, no shader grid. Same key names as the cyber theme; only values change. To retheme, edit values here only.

category._comment: Legend category → color. Single primary blue for buildings, mint for garage.

building._comment: v1.4 楼栋楼层/房间层次（§4）。简约：roomShade 较小保持汇报友好、可打印；dividerColor 用单一主色描边作楼层虚线。

shaders._comment: Not used by the minimal style — flat materials, no post-processing. Generator skips grid.glsl when spec.style != 'cyber'.

environment._comment: v1.2 园区环境配色（§10）。简约气质：低饱和单色，无发光。道路浅灰、草地浅绿、单一主色描边。groundGlow 默认关。

garageEntrance._comment: v1.4 地下车库入口标记（§5）。扁平单色 + 描边。signBg/signFg 高对比（浅底深字）。

surfaceParking._comment: v1.4 地面车位（§10）。长方形车位，浅色铺装 + 深描边，浅底深字 P，哑光车辆。旧 frame/sign 已废弃保留兼容。

poi._comment: v1.3 兴趣点（§11）类型→颜色。简约：低饱和、可打印、不发光。
